brief: Drs. Karim Ali and Zain Chagla (infectious diseases) and Attorney General of Ontario counsel, mid-2021; clinical, academic and admin business unrelated to the expert report, duty acknowledgements or religious-gathering limits.

documents.subject: Journal club - July topic
documents.body:
Karim,

For the July infectious diseases journal club, how about the recent paper on outpatient antimicrobial stewardship in long-term care? I can present if you moderate.

Zain
documents.why_irrelevant: Near miss: the two deponents on the affirming day; about a teaching journal club.

documents.subject: Minutes of Division Meeting
documents.body:
1. On-call schedule for August finalized.

2. Fellow orientation set for July 5.

3. Antibiotic formulary changes for cefazolin dosing reviewed.
documents.why_irrelevant: Clinical division business attended by both deponents.

documents.subject: Updated guidance on vancomycin monitoring
documents.body: Effective July 12, area-under-the-curve dosing replaces trough monitoring for vancomycin on inpatient units. Pharmacy will provide calculators on the intranet.
documents.why_irrelevant: Clinical practice memo; not about COVID-19 transmission or public health measures.
